mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_decision_command ( tenant_id, idempotency_key, payload_hash, state_name, response_json, created_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{payloadHash}, #{stateName}, #{responseJson}, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT payload_hash AS payloadHash, state_name AS stateName, response_json AS responseJson FROM mk_decision_command WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_runtime_generation ( tenant_id, environment_name, cell_id, runtime_name, namespace_name, generation_no, release_key_id, manifest_json, artifact_payload, manifest_signature, warmed_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{environmentName}, #{cellId}, #{runtimeName}, #{namespaceName}, #{generationNo}, #{releaseKeyId}, #{manifestJson}, #{artifactPayload}, #{manifestSignature}, #{warmedAt} )

INSERT INTO mk_runtime_slot ( tenant_id, environment_name, cell_id, runtime_name, namespace_name, desired_generation, activation_sequence, directive_signature, directive_json, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{environmentName}, #{cellId}, #{runtimeName}, #{namespaceName}, #{desiredGeneration}, #{activationSequence}, #{directiveSignature}, #{directiveJson}, #{updatedAt} )

INSERT INTO mk_audience_membership_projection ( tenant_id, audience_id, subject_hash, member_value, membership_version, expires_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{tenantId}, #{audienceId}, #{subjectHash}, #{memberValue}, #{membershipVersion}, #{expiresAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, audience_id AS audienceId, subject_hash AS subjectHash, member_value AS memberValue, membership_version AS membershipVersion, expires_at AS expiresAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM mk_audience_membership_projection WHERE updated_at >= #{updatedSince} ORDER BY updated_at
